description:
Virtual File System for Git - a tool to scale Git for monorepo scenarios.


What's Changed
- Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs by Dan Fiedler (@danfiedler-msft) in #2093
- HttpRequestor: do not reject credentials on HTTP 400 by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2088
- Auto-recover corrupt packfiles in packfile maintenance by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2052
- Fix upgrade tests when the LKG release has multiple installers by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2097
- Share transient libgit2 config lookup helper by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2066
- Capture mount dumps and preserve logs when a functional test fails by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2062
- FunctionalTests: make shared control-repo cache setup resilient by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2099
- Split enumeration-miss cause + extract EnumerationFailureTracker + de-duplicate error telemetry by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2076
- Route GVFS endpoints to dedicated cache servers by Derrick Stolee (@derrickstolee) in #2103
- Disable Git fsmonitor in virtual repositories by Tyrie Vella (@tyrielv) in #2106

New Contributors
- Dan Fiedler (@danfiedler-msft) made their first contribution in #2093
